designationHistory.indexText: Sunkhaze Meadows NWR was established administratively in 1988 to ensure the ecological integrity of the Sunkhaze Meadows Unit peat bog and to conserve wetland, stream, and forest habitats, and associated wildlife.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
